assertions.assertion: The payer that denied the claim is Blue Summit Plan.
CPT 93271 corresponds to cardiac event monitoring.
The denial was issued under reason code PR-204.
Reason code PR-204 indicates the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's condition.
The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations.
The patient has subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats.
The symptoms prompted further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2.
The clinical indication is consistent with diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2.
The cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances.
The study captures electrocardiographic data during symptom onset.
Reconsideration of the PR-204 denial and payment is being requested.
